name: pi-yolo-auto
description: Pi provider extension for the Yolo-Auto flat-rate Qwen3.8-27B API (OpenAI-compatible, stale-while-revalidate model catalog sync, subscription usage).

scripts.check: node --check index.ts && node --check models.ts && node --check usage.ts && node --check scripts/update-models.js && node --check scripts/release-notes.mjs && node --check scripts/live-provider-probe.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch -m "chore(release): %s" && git push --follow-tags && npm publish
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor -m "chore(release): %s" && git push --follow-tags && npm publish

author: Ryan Brosas
